title: Getting Started with figsr
text: figsr implements Fast Interpretable Greedy-Tree Sums (FIGS) (Tan et al., PNAS 2023). FIGS fits sum shallow decision trees, \hat{f}(x) = \sum_k \hat{f}_k(x), one split time. every step algorithm compares single global pool candidates: opening new tree full sample, splitting leaf every tree already grown. candidate largest reduction residual sum squares wins, residuals recomputed whole sum next step. whole idea: grow new tree deepen existing one, whichever helps . pay-additive structure modeled additively. single CART tree repeat subtree every combination two independent effects; FIGS puts effect small tree.
